# ui::ColorAnimator

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

Runs a [BrushTransition](brush-transition.md) for a control that owns a background. It remembers the color on screen when the background changed and blends from it to the new one. It animates only between two colors. A background appearing or disappearing changes at once.

Example: 
```cpp
class Swatch : public ui::Element
{
    // Changing color: remember what is on screen now, then blend to the new one.
    void set_color(ui::Color c)
    {
        animator_.retarget(animator_.current(color_), c, ui::BrushTransition{});
        color_ = c;
        mark_dirty(ui::DirtyFlags::Visual);
    }
    void tick_override(ui::Duration delta) override
    {
        if (animator_.advance(delta))
            mark_dirty(ui::DirtyFlags::Visual);
    }
    void render_override(ui::Renderer& r, const ui::RenderContext&) const override
    {
        if (const auto c = animator_.current(color_))
            r.fill_rounded_rect(bounds(), 4.0f, *c);
    }
    // measure_override() etc. omitted

    std::optional<ui::Color> color_;
    ui::ColorAnimator        animator_;
};
```

## retarget

```cpp
void retarget(std::optional<Color> from, std::optional<Color> to, const std::optional<BrushTransition>& transition)
```

The background is changing from `from` (what [current()](#current) draws right now) to `to`. Starts a blend only when `transition` is set, both colors are set and differ, and animations are on; otherwise stops any running blend so the new color shows at once.

## advance

```cpp
bool advance(Duration delta)
```

Advances the blend by `delta`; returns true while blending (including the step that finishes it), so the owner knows to repaint.

## current

```cpp
std::optional<Color> current(const std::optional<Color>& target) const
```

The color to draw for a background whose value is `target`: the blend from the remembered color while active, `target` itself otherwise.

## active

```cpp
bool active() const
```

Whether a blend is in progress.
